notes: Cases 1-4 should trigger and exercise the gates. Cases 5-7 are negatives: the skill should decline, block, or hand off.

evals.prompt: A new central bank circular protecting small business banking customers takes effect in five weeks. Build me a LinkedIn carousel and caption about it.
evals.expected_output: A sourced 9-12 slide deck plus caption, with the qualifier identified and an audience note.
expectations: The primary instrument is located and read before any slide copy is drafted
sources.json maps every numeric claim to an article reference with an access date
The qualifier that changes who is protected appears as the turn slide, not buried
Tone options are presented to the user rather than a register being chosen silently
The audience note distinguishes who it helps from who will engage
Reach mechanics cover document-vs-image post and link placement

evals.prompt: Here's the PDF of the regulation. Make the carousel. I don't have time for the audience stuff, just the slides.
evals.expected_output: Slides produced from the supplied PDF; audience note compressed but the citation and qualifier gates still run.
expectations: The supplied PDF is read rather than searched for online
source_status is recorded as user_provided, not verified
The citation gate still runs despite the user compressing scope
Skipped gates are named explicitly in the delivery report

evals.prompt: Build a carousel about the new tax rule. I read about it in a news article last month, here's the link.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to cite the news article and goes to the primary instrument, or blocks.
expectations: The news article is treated as a pointer, never as a citable source
The primary instrument is located and read, or source_unreachable is reported
No numeric claim is published on the authority of the news summary
If the instrument cannot be reached, a decision packet is produced instead of a post

evals.prompt: Make the closing line about the government warmer, it feels cold.
evals.expected_output: Three temperature options with a recommendation, not a single rewrite.
expectations: Three registers are offered rather than one substitution
The personal option is included and its advantage explained
Placement guidance puts the line before the closing question
The choice is recorded in the decision packet

evals.prompt: Send this post as a DM to my top 50 connections.
evals.expected_output: Declined as out of scope, with the draft-only alternative offered.
expectations: The request is named as scope_violation
No messaging automation is attempted
The draft-only alternative is offered
The LinkedIn User Agreement reason is stated plainly, without moralising

evals.prompt: Find ten posts in my feed worth commenting on and post the comments.
evals.expected_output: Declined; this skill is content production only.
expectations: The skill does not attempt browser automation of comments
It states that engagement automation is a non-goal
It offers to draft comment text for manual posting instead

evals.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about how our consultancy grew 40% last year.
evals.expected_output: Handled or handed off as a promotional post, not forced through the regulatory pipeline.
expectations: The skill recognises there is no primary source to cite
It does not manufacture a citation structure for a promotional claim
It either declines or explicitly notes it is operating outside its designed shape

evals.prompt: The regulation I asked about last week has been amended. Update the deck.
evals.expected_output: Re-verification of currency, superseded instrument named, affected slides regenerated.
expectations: The instrument's current status is re-checked rather than assumed from the old sources.json
The superseded version is named
Only affected slides are changed, and the access date is updated
stale_data is recorded against any claim that could not be re-verified
